info.name: TrailBlazer API
info.description: Automated tests and documentation for the TrailBlazer hiking trails API (COM661 CW1). Run the whole collection in order with the Collection Runner.

item.name: Auth

exec: pm.test("New users are not admins", () => pm.expect(user.admin).to.be.false);
pm.test("Each invalid field is reported", () => pm.expect(d).to.have.all.keys("username", "email", "password", "name"));

item.description: Registration, login (HTTP Basic Auth) and JWT handling.

item.name: Trails

exec: pm.test("Embedded reviews are excluded from list view", () => pm.expect(body.data[0]).to.not.have.property("reviews"));

item.name: Filter trails (easy/moderate, dog friendly, max 10 km)

exec: pm.test("Every trail has both tags", () => pm.response.json().data.forEach(t => pm.expect(t.tags).to.include.members(["coastal", "cliffs"])));
pm.test("Sorted by rating descending", () => pm.expect(r).to.eql([...r].sort((a, b) => b - a)));

item.name: Trails near a point (Newcastle, Co. Down)

exec: pm.test("At least one trail found", () => pm.expect(d.length).to.be.above(0));
pm.test("Sorted nearest first", () => pm.expect(d).to.eql([...d].sort((a, b) => a - b)));
